title: Build Done capture cases from MakeMe launch steps

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage: one break check

Story and revision: .planning/seeds/SEED-413-renovate-dashboard-unit-tests.md, "Build Done capture cases from MakeMe launch steps" (fold-done-capture-launches-into-makeme), plan 737. Revision 34064ecded7e1f2e4594cf679d38eff71f827cc9, checked out in an isolated detached scratch worktree with `npm ci`. Before the probe, `git status` showed no tracked changes.

Promise (key example 2): "A dirty entry still preserves its first tree and Default main tip." A second branch entry at the same place answers the entry first kept, not a fresh capture.

Verdict: Caught, only on the proposal path.

Fault (one temporary edit, fixtures and assertions untouched): dashboard/server/branchEntryProposal.ts, proposeBranchEntry. Removed the early `if (previous !== undefined) return { kept: true, entry: previous };`, so a re-entry still said kept: true but carried the current tree, committedTip and defaultTip instead of the first ones. The edit also wrote a stderr witness line (IC-WITNESS) whenever a kept entry was overwritten.

Maintained checks examined (focused command, 2 files, 7 tests):
- branch-entry-proposal.spec.ts "the same place proposes the kept entry after main and the worktree move" caught the fault: `expect(await proposeBranchEntry(...{ ...record, branchEntry: entry }...)).toEqual({ kept: true, entry })` at line 126 failed.
- ad-hoc-session-branch-entry.spec.ts "a declared branch keeps its entry state and Default main tip after main moves" passed under the fault and never reached the faulted path: its second recordSessionBranchEntry call passes the original record without branchEntry, so the store-side guard in recordSessionBranchEntry keeps the entry. Not an assertion gap for this fault; that test guards a different code path.

Run observations: baseline 7/7 (11.41 s); faulted 1 failed, 6 passed (8.43 s), only the proposal kept-entry test; independent witness printed once on the intended path (first tree 43e9ba89 / defaultTip 102578f8 / committedTip 75ae745c replaced by 5477e681 / 6a48bdf9 / 76853db0); restored via EXIT trap, status and diff empty, rerun 7/7 (5.79 s); scratch worktree removed.

Next proof action: none needed for this fault on the proposal path. Optional and outside this probe: a separate probe of the store-side re-entry guard in recordSessionBranchEntry. No already-planned repair matches this evidence.

Cost: test runtime about 25.6 s measured; npm ci not measured; human effort none; agent effort unavailable (about 10 tool calls, estimated). Invocation-to-report elapsed 95980 ms (measured).

## Wrap-up disposition

Checked revision 34064ecded7e1f2e4594cf679d38eff71f827cc9: Caught; no follow-up.
